scope: Exact previously exposed Pi development pool of 34 tasks, unchanged revisions, images, resources, official tests and native limits. The other 55 tasks remained unopened. 34 formal jobs, 32 model executions, no replacement tasks or whole-trial replay.

model_policy.alias: Official documentation checked 2026-10-30 maps the mutable deepseek-flash alias to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.

budget_policy: Original task-native timeouts/resources; 1800-second setup. Upstream sdk-minimal prompts, tools, compaction, retries, and generation defaults. No injected turn limit, internal time budget, or finalization reminders. Pi used OpenAI-compatible transport with 384000-token model metadata; this is not a matched-generation-budget causal harness comparison.
accounting_policy: Native rewards, exceptions and standard summaries are unchanged. Confirmed timeout outputs with completed official tests remain scoreable; setup failures, terminal provider transport failure and verifier dependency failures remain analytically null. Service-lifecycle failures are retained as failures of this measured SDK configuration. This is not a complete 34-task pass rate or a causal agent-quality comparison.

usage.policy: Known SDK usage subtotals only. Interrupted requests and failed native retries can lack usage. Cache tokens are already included in input; do not add them again. No provider billing or price-derived cost is asserted.

timing.interpretation: Queue wall time includes setup, verifier retries, and pair barriers. Dates, API failures, package downloads and different accepted task sets prevent a controlled latency comparison.

historical_comparison.caveats: Both losses have the confirmed SDK service-lifecycle caveat. WAL passes here but was unscored in Pi and is not a paired gain. Pi sampler and WAL have legacy invalid/unverified boundaries; Pi pipeline pass has public reference-test/solution exposure. Different dates, mutable alias, Messages versus OpenAI-compatible endpoints and 256000 versus 384000 output ceilings prevent causal harness attribution.

validation.final_harbor_test_note: 273 passed and 7 local HTTP fixtures were blocked by sandbox socket permissions; all 280 passed with local sockets permitted.

image_transport_audit.policy: Original image identities and repository digests checked for every preflight/formal task. Only newly introduced image references evicted without force; initially protected images retained.

exposure_audit.method: After freezing all outputs, targeted scan of recorded tool calls and paired candidate outputs for benchmark repositories, hidden test paths and environment access; exact byte matching of the authorized provider credential across 2506 frozen files. Not an exhaustive proof of absence of exposure or exfiltration.
exposure_audit.findings: Terminal-Bench strings in a calendar PRODID and the task-provided C++ canary are not reference retrieval. MTEB accessed legitimate public embeddings-benchmark/results application data at 3125e8302256ac01d4dd68b6f92902b3e6a78987. No external Terminal-Bench reference retrieval or official hidden test access was observed in the scanned calls and candidate outputs.
